answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 152172 Country: Pakistan Title: My name is Nasimullah and it was named by my late father soon after my birth. Maulana I want to ask that is it correct name and permissible under Islamic laws. Question: My name is Nasimullah and it was named by my late father soon after my birth. Maulana I want to ask that is it correct name and permissible under Islamic laws. Answer ID: 152172 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1039/1013/B=10/1438) Yes, your name is correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
